title: ARGUMAP Annotation Schema Specification
description: Defines the canonical data representation for ARGUMAP human annotations and ground-truth argument mining files.

debate_id.description: Unique identifier for the debate session or document.

title.description: Human-readable title or motion of the debate.

source_corpus.description: Originating corpus identifier matching data/dataset_manifest.json (e.g., qt30, us2016, custom).

source_license.description: License applicable to the source material.

guideline_version.description: Version of ANNOTATION_GUIDELINES.md used during annotation (e.g., 1.0.0).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the annotation document (e.g. UNANNOTATED_TEMPLATE, UNANNOTATED_PILOT_PACKAGE, ANNOTATED_GOLD).

candidate_relation_policy.description: Identifier or descriptor of relation candidate generation policy (e.g. provisional_directional_k3).

pilot_selection.description: Metadata regarding bounded pilot selection (e.g. selection method, source turns, unit ranges).

instructions.description: Annotator instructions and ambiguity resolution protocol.

turn_id.description: Identifier of the speech turn containing this unit.

turn_index.description: Zero-based sequential index of the turn within the debate transcript.

speaker_id.description: Identifier of the speaker who uttered this proposition.

speaker_side.description: Stance or faction in the debate (e.g., 'Affirmative', 'Negative', 'Neutral').

unit_id.description: Unique identifier for this argument unit (e.g., 'u_001').

unit_text.description: Verbatim text of the segmented proposition.

char_start.description: Starting character index (0-indexed, inclusive) in the turn text.

char_end.description: Ending character index (exclusive) in the turn text.

annotator_id.description: Identifier of the human annotator or adjudication panel.

note.description: Optional annotator remarks, edge-case rationale, or tie-break notes.

source_unit_id.description: Unit ID of the source proposition (tail of directed relation edge).

target_unit_id.description: Unit ID of the target proposition (head of directed relation edge).

same_speaker.description: True if source and target units share the same speaker.

cross_turn.description: True if source and target units occur in different speech turns.

turn_distance.description: Absolute turn distance between source turn index and target turn index (|turn_source - turn_target|).

is_override.description: True if relation is an explicit long-range override outside the standard candidate window (e.g. k > 3).

annotator_id.description: Identifier of the human annotator or adjudicator.

note.description: Optional annotator remarks on relation nuances.
